actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]], and if the target is Large or smaller, the cloaker attaches to it. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage against the target, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} attaches to the target's head, and the target is &Reference[blinded] and unable to &Reference[suffocation apply=false]{Breathe} while the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is attached. While attached, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can make this attack only against the target and has advantage on the attack roll. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. A creature, including the target, can take its action to detach the cloaker by succeeding on a [[/check]] check.

actions.name: damage transfer
actions.desc: While attached to a creature, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes only half the damage dealt to it (rounded down) and that creature takes the other half.

actions.name: false appearance
actions.desc: While the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} remains motionless without its underside exposed, it is indistinguishable from a dark leather cloak.

actions.name: light sensitivity
actions.desc: While in &reference[bright light], the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The cloaker makes two attacks: one with its [[/item .afXMbT7smRaCJbhc]]{bite} and one with its [[/item .ZRvdvg8n7pQdJ1Mj]]{tail}.

actions.name: moan
actions.desc: Each creature within 60 feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} that can hear its moan and that isn't an aberration must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or become &Reference[frightened] until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn. If a creature's saving throw is successful, the creature is immune to the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s [[lookup @item.name]] for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: phantasms
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} magically creates three illusory duplicates of itself if it isn't in &reference[bright light]. The duplicates move with it and mimic its actions, shifting position so as to make it impossible to track which [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is the real one. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is ever in an area of bright light, the duplicates disappear. Whenever any creature targets the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} with an attack or a harmful spell while a duplicate remains, that creature rolls randomly to determine whether it targets the cloaker or one of the duplicates. A creature is unaffected by this magical effect if it can't see or if it relies on senses other than sight. A duplicate has the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s AC and uses its saving throws. If an attack hits a duplicate, or if a duplicate fails a saving throw against an effect that deals damage, the duplicate disappears.
